scenes: What happens when Asia’s water towers melt?
In the Hindu Kush Himalaya, glaciers lost ice sixty-five per cent faster in the 2010s. | By 2100 they could lose thirty to fifty per cent of their volume.
First, more meltwater, and the risk of floods. | Later, less water in the dry season, for the rivers people farm and drink from.
Heat in the mountains reaches every river below.
